name: SecondPartnerActivationStateMachine
description: Formal state machine definition for Purple Garden's second-partner invitation, onboarding, and activation journey with hardened acceptance idempotency, couple row locking, non-persisted fallback display names, and controlled target statuses.

idle_uninvited.description: User has not clicked an invitation link. Standard application entry point.

validating_invite_token.description: Client captures opaque URL token string and checks session status. Token string is cached in memory/intent storage without partner names or event details.

checking_auth_session.description: Evaluates Supabase session state to determine whether user must authenticate before resolving token state.

prompting_auth_with_intent.description: Displays welcoming login/signup card with return intent preserved strictly to allowlisted internal route: /invite/[token].

awaiting_email_confirmation.description: User created an account and must confirm their email before continuing.

evaluating_user_couple_status.description: Server RPC validates token hash and checks acceptance idempotency first, followed by consumption, revocation, expiration, and active couple membership.

already_same_couple.description: Idempotent repeat acceptance: user previously accepted this invitation and remains an active member of this couple. Continues directly to shared space even if 7-day expiry has passed.

different_active_couple.description: User already belongs to another relationship space. Acceptance is blocked; user must switch accounts or return to their own space.
different_active_couple.recoveryAction: Offer clear choice to sign out and switch accounts, or return safely to their existing relationship space.

wrong_account.description: User is signed into an account not intended for this invitation. Offers explicit sign-out/sign-in (never automatic membership transfer).

confirming_explicit_join.description: Presents clear, unhurried choice to join Partner A's space with privacy guarantees. Never joins silently.

completing_minimal_onboarding.description: Fast-path onboarding gate: presents privacy/sharing explanation, optional preferred display name, and explicit confirmation action. If preferred name is omitted/blank, profiles.display_name is left NULL (never persists 'Partner' to DB). On successful completion, atomic RPC inserts couple membership, sets profiles.onboarding_completed = true, syncs UserIdentityContext, and transitions to verifying_target_moment. All deferred profile fields remain available later via Settings -> Profile. Normal signup retains 3-step onboarding.

verifying_target_moment.description: Server-authorized verification of optional target_event_id returning controlled status: 'available', 'reconnected', or 'unavailable'. Even if unavailable, couple join remains successful.

target_available.description: Authoritative server status: target friction moment is open, shared with this couple, and accessible. Informs user and routes to the three-choice first-moment arrival layer.

target_reconnected.description: Authoritative server status: target friction moment has already been completed, repaired, or settled. Informs user gently that the moment was completed and routes to positive discovery.

target_unavailable.description: Authoritative server status for deleted, private, foreign, or missing target events. Target event ID is returned as null. Informs user calmly without speculating on reasons; couple space join succeeded. Routes to positive discovery.

positive_discovery.description: Welcoming, positive post-join discovery state when target moment is unavailable or reconnected. Introduces Our Space, Shared Garden, and Good Moments.

first_moment_choice_layer.description: Triage layer on first visit: Give me some time, Reflect privately, or Ready to respond.

configuring_private_snooze.description: Modal offering 'Until tomorrow' (24h) or 'Give me a week' (7d) private snooze. Tracked per-user in relationship_event_attention_states.

authoring_private_reflection.description: Dedicated editor for private personal reflection. Isolated via RLS from partner.

post_reflection_choices.description: After saving note: choose between keeping it private or transitioning to a shared response.

drafting_arrival_response.description: Selection of structured arrival response: heard, need_time, or suggest_next_step.

positive_handoff.description: One-time welcoming handoff introducing Shared Garden, Our Space, and Good Moments. Completed ONLY through explicit destination selection or 'Maybe later'. Render-only leaves handoff uncompleted.

positive_handoff_deferred.description: User clicked 'Maybe later' on positive handoff. Handoff marked completed for this couple in couple_user_experience_states without forcing immediate navigation.

viewing_shared_garden.description: Partner B inspects the shared procedural garden flora derived deterministically.

recording_good_moment.description: Partner B initiates a positive shared moment for the couple.

visiting_our_space.description: Partner B browses shared event timeline in Our Space.

active_equal_partner_space.description: Fully active, equal co-ownership state. Standard Home and Our Space navigation.

invite_expired.description: Unconsumed invitation token exceeded 7-day TTL (expires_at <= now()). No countdown or urgency language.
invite_expired.recoveryAction: Prompt Partner B to ask Partner A for a new invitation whenever they are ready.

invite_revoked.description: Unconsumed invitation was revoked by creator (revoked_at IS NOT NULL) before acceptance.
invite_revoked.recoveryAction: Return user safely to main landing screen without leaking creator details.

invite_already_used.description: Single-use invitation token was already accepted by another user account (accepted_by != auth.uid()).
invite_already_used.recoveryAction: Fail closed and offer general sign-in or account switch.

invitation_regenerated.description: Inviter generated a fresh replacement invitation, which revoked this unconsumed token.
invitation_regenerated.recoveryAction: Inform Partner B that a newer invitation code is available and prompt them to use the latest link from their partner.

invite_invalid.description: Token digest hash does not exist in couple_invites.
invite_invalid.recoveryAction: Offer general signup or sign-in link without leaking database state.

invite_deferred.recoveryAction: Retain clean solo home state. Invitation can be re-opened later within the 7-day validity window.

network_recovery_invite.description: Network connection dropped during invite verification.

guards.isAlreadyAcceptedByCallerAndActiveMember: inviteRow.accepted_at != null && inviteRow.accepted_by === auth.uid() && userActiveCoupleId === inviteRow.couple_id
guards.isSupersededByRegeneration: inviteRow.accepted_at == null && inviteRow.revoked_at != null && inviteRow.superseded == true
guards.isEligibleToJoin: inviteRow.accepted_at == null && inviteRow.revoked_at == null && inviteRow.expires_at > now() && userActiveCoupleId == null

privacyInvariants: Raw invitation tokens are 32 cryptographically random bytes encoded as lowercase hexadecimal (exactly 64 characters, regex ^[0-9a-f]{64}$, 256 bits of entropy) and returned to inviter exactly once.
Raw invitation tokens are never stored in the database; only token_hash (SHA-256 digest of the 64-character raw string) is persisted.

Acceptance strictly requires exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters matching ^[0-9a-f]{64}$; computes SHA-256 digest on server using extensions.digest with empty search_path before comparing to token_hash; raw token is never logged or stored.
A stolen token_hash cannot be used as the bearer credential.
Token comparison must avoid unnecessary information disclosure (calm generic exceptions).
Client intent storage contains ONLY the opaque 64-character invitation token string.
Partner names and event content must never be persisted in localStorage or AsyncStorage.
Authentication return routes must be strictly allowlisted internal routes (/invite/[token] only).
Server-authorized token resolution determines the final route destination.
Display name fallback is strictly 'your partner' in prose and 'Partner' in labels; never derived from an email address and NEVER persisted to profiles.display_name when omitted.

Invited-user onboarding fast-path sets profiles.onboarding_completed = true ONLY upon explicit authenticated confirmation with optional preferred name and 'Continue to the shared moment'; never on render, 'Not now', auth drop, or failure; deferred profile fields remain editable in Settings -> Profile; normal signup retains standard 3-step onboarding.

Recommended MVP executes membership acceptance, optional preferred-name update, and onboarding completion atomically in one RPC; fallback two-step model requires individual idempotency without duplicate memberships.

Moment-specific invitations for this repair journey target strictly relationship_events.event_type = 'friction' with visibility = 'ours' belonging to the invitation couple; Good moments do not enter repair triage; general invitations have target_event_id = null and route to positive discovery.

Controlled target statuses are strictly available, reconnected, or unavailable; deleted, private, foreign, or missing targets map uniformly to unavailable with target_event_id = null; client never claims to know reason for unavailability.
Target event integrity requires invite.couple_id = target_event.couple_id enforced via create RPC validation, trigger, or supported composite foreign key.
Positive handoff completion is tracked per user per couple in couple_user_experience_states, never as a global profile flag.
Positive handoff is marked complete ONLY upon explicit destination selection or tapping 'Maybe later'; render-only leaves handoff uncompleted.
Same-couple invitation acceptance is idempotent (already_same_couple); continues even if 7-day expiry has passed.
Different active-couple membership blocks acceptance (different_active_couple).
Wrong-account recovery offers sign-out and sign-in; never automatic membership transfer.
Invitation lifetime is 7 days with zero countdown or false urgency language.
Invitation replacement revokes ONLY unconsumed invitations where accepted_at IS NULL.
Acceptance locks both the couple_invites row and public.couples row FOR UPDATE to eliminate concurrent membership overcapacity races.
Both creation and acceptance enforce the database's authoritative active-membership definition, rejecting users with multiple or zero active couples.
Token parameter is stripped from visible browser URL after safe client ingestion.
No third-party trackers or scripts on token landing pages; tokens are never logged or sent to analytics.

Developer reconciliation: General invitations have invite_purpose = 'general' with target_status as null or 'no_target' (does not pretend a target became unavailable); moment invitations have invite_purpose = 'moment' returning 'available', 'reconnected', or 'unavailable'.

Developer reconciliation: token_hash storage type is recommended as bytea NOT NULL UNIQUE compared directly against digest(raw_token, 'sha256'); if text is used instead, both creation and acceptance must use encoded hexadecimal consistently.

Database event type contract: Established positive event value in database is event_type = 'positive' (not 'good'); customer-facing copy refers to 'Good moments' but data model strictly enforces 'positive'.
